Links and Media Reference

Portable clips need meaningful destinations. Relative references are resolved against the page URL before conversion so that downloaded notes continue to work outside the original site.

Read the complete handbook, then visit the community page for discussion and examples.

Images retain useful alternative text. Decorative loading attributes and responsive source lists do not need to appear in the final Markdown document.

These fixtures are original examples created for Clip2MD and can be redistributed with the project.
